summary: Gossamer Bio filed an 8-K on August 20, 2026, reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of pre-funded warrants, with two closings. The initial closing, expected August 24, 2026, involves pre-funded warrants exercisable for up to 25,000 Series A-1 preferred shares pre-approval or ~178.7 million common shares post-approval, priced at $0.1399 per warrant, raising ~$25.0 million gross. The second closing, contingent on FDA acceptance of the NDA for seralutinib in 2026, would raise ~$125 million. Purchasers include executive officers and directors. Structurally, this is an equity financing, not a capital return; classification as Capital Returns is likely incorrect, but given the filing's nature, 'None' or a financing-related category may be more appropriate. Watch for stockholder approval and FDA acceptance catalysts.
